mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_status = #{submitStatus} and mws.remark like concat('%', #{remark}, '%')
and mu.nick_name like concat('%', #{submitNickName}, '%')
and (mp.product_code like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%') or mp.product_name like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%'))
and (mpc.process_code like concat('%', #{processNameOrCode}, '%') or mpc.process_name like concat('%', #{processNameOrCode}, '%'))

select a.submit_user operator, a.created_date operateDate, a.product_seq productSeq, a.operate_process_seq processSeq, b.process_name processName, c.product_name productName from micro_work_submit a left join micro_process_common b on a.operate_process_seq = b.process_seq and a.tenant_code = b.tenant_code left join micro_product c on a.product_seq = c.product_seq and a.tenant_code = c.tenant_code where a.submit_type = '1' and a.submit_user != #{userId} order by a.created_date limit 1

select a.check_user operator, a.check_date operateDate, a.product_seq productSeq, a.operate_process_seq processSeq, b.process_name processName, c.product_name productName from micro_work_submit a left join micro_process_common b on a.operate_process_seq = b.process_seq and a.tenant_code = b.tenant_code left join micro_product c on a.product_seq = c.product_seq and a.tenant_code = c.tenant_code where a.submit_status = '0' and a.submit_type = '1' and a.check_user != #{userId} order by a.check_date limit 1

SELECT IFNULL(sum(a.total_pass_num), 0) as total_pass_num, IFNULL(sum(a.total_ng_num), 0) as total_ng_num, IFNULL(sum(a.total_num), 0) as total_num, a.submit_user, a.submit_day FROM (SELECT IFNULL(sum(check_pass_num), 0) as total_pass_num, IFNULL(sum(check_ng_num), 0) as total_ng_num, IFNULL(sum(check_pass_num + check_ng_num), 0) as total_num, submit_user, submit_day FROM micro_work_submit WHERE submit_day = DATE_FORMAT(#{submitDay}, '%Y-%m-%d') and submit_status = '0' and submit_type = '1' group by submit_user UNION SELECT IFNULL(sum(pass_num), 0) as total_pass_num, IFNULL(sum(ng_num), 0) as total_ng_num, IFNULL(sum(pass_num + ng_num), 0) as total_num, submit_user, submit_day FROM micro_work_submit WHERE submit_day = DATE_FORMAT(#{submitDay}, '%Y-%m-%d') and submit_status = '1' and submit_type = '1' group by submit_user) a group by a.submit_user

SELECT IFNULL(sum(check_pass_num) + sum(check_ng_num), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT submit_day) as avgDayProductiveCapacityForFactory FROM micro_work_submit WHERE submit_day < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') and submit_status = '0' and submit_type = '1'

SELECT IFNULL(sum(a.avgDayProductiveCapacityForEmployee), 0) / COUNT(*) AS avgDayProductiveCapacityForEmployee FROM (SELECT submit_day, IFNULL(sum(check_pass_num) + sum(check_ng_num), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT submit_user) AS avgDayProductiveCapacityForEmployee FROM micro_work_submit WHERE submit_day < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AND submit_status = '0' and submit_type = '1' GROUP BY submit_day) AS a

SELECT submit_user as submitUser, IFNULL(sum(check_pass_num) + sum(check_ng_num), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT submit_day) as averageDayProductiveCapacityForEmployee FROM micro_work_submit WHERE submit_day < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') and submit_status = '0' and submit_type = '1' GROUP BY submit_user

select mws.id, mws.tenant_code, mws.work_order_no, mws.task_no, mws.submit_type, mws.product_seq, mp.product_code, mp.product_name, mws.pre_process_seq, mws.operate_process_seq, mpc.process_name as operate_process_name, mpc.process_code as operate_process_code, mws.pre_process_group, mws.operate_process_group, mws.is_last_process, mws.pass_num, mws.ng_num, mws.submit_user, mws.submit_day, mws.submit_status, mws.submit_no, mws.remark, mws.created_by, mws.created_date, mws.check_user, mws.check_date, mws.check_pass_num, mws.check_ng_num, mws.last_upd_by, mws.last_upd_date, mws.data_status, mws.expired_record_flag, mws.submit_pictures, mws.is_first_process, mws.is_complete, mws.check_status, mws.repair_num, mws.abandoned_num, mws.qc_date, mws.qc_user from micro_work_submit mws left join micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq left join micro_process_common mpc on mpc.process_seq = mws.operate_process_seq
and submit_user = #{submitUser} and submit_day >= date_format(#{submitStartDay}, '%Y-%m-%d') and submit_day <= date_format(#{submitEndDay}, '%Y-%m-%d') and submit_type = #{submitType} and submit_status = #{submitStatus}

SELECT a.submit_day as submitDay, IFNULL(sum(a.total_num), 0) AS totalNum FROM (SELECT IFNULL(sum(check_pass_num + check_ng_num), 0) AS total_num, submit_day FROM micro_work_submit WHERE submit_user = #{userId} and submit_type = '1' and submit_status = '0' GROUP BY submit_day UNION SELECT IFNULL(sum(pass_num + ng_num), 0) AS total_num, submit_day FROM micro_work_submit WHERE submit_user = #{userId} and submit_type = '1' and submit_status = '1' GROUP BY submit_day) a GROUP BY a.submit_day

select * from (SELECT mpc.process_name AS itemName, mpc.process_code AS itemCode, mpc.process_seq AS itemSeq, mpc.id AS itemId FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON mws.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code AND mws.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq WHERE mws.submit_status = '0' and mws.submit_type = '1' AND mws.product_seq = #{productSeq} AND mpc.process_name like concat('%', #{key}, '%') GROUP BY mpc.process_name, mpc.process_seq, mpc.process_code UNION SELECT mpc.process_name AS itemName, mpc.process_code AS itemCode, mpc.process_seq AS itemSeq, mpc.id AS itemId FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON mws.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code AND FIND_IN_SET(mpc.process_seq, mws.pre_process_seq) WHERE mws.submit_status = '0' and mws.submit_type = '1' AND mws.product_seq = #{productSeq} AND mpc.process_name like concat('%', #{key}, '%') GROUP BY mpc.process_name, mpc.process_seq, mpc.process_code) as t order by t.itemCode

SELECT SUM(IFNULL(a.total_num, 0)) as totalSubmitNum, group_concat(ids) as ids, concat(product_seq, '_', operate_process_seq, '_', submit_user, '_', submit_day) as conditionKey FROM ( SELECT SUM(IFNULL(check_pass_num, 0)) + SUM(IFNULL(check_ng_num, 0)) AS total_num, null as ids, product_seq, operate_process_seq, submit_user, submit_day FROM micro_work_submit where submit_status = 0 and submit_type = '1' group by product_seq, operate_process_seq, submit_user, submit_day UNION ALL SELECT SUM(IFNULL(pass_num, 0)) + SUM(IFNULL(ng_num, 0))AS total_num, group_concat(id) as ids, product_seq, operate_process_seq, submit_user, submit_day FROM micro_work_submit where submit_status = 1 and submit_type = '1' group by product_seq, operate_process_seq, submit_user, submit_day ) a group by product_seq, operate_process_seq, submit_user, submit_day

SELECT DISTINCT mws.operate_process_seq AS process_seq FROM micro_work_submit mws UNION SELECT DISTINCT mws.pre_process_seq AS process_seq FROM micro_work_submit mws WHERE (mws.pre_process_seq IS NOT NULL OR mws.pre_process_seq != '') UNION SELECT DISTINCT mps.process_seq AS process_seq FROM micro_process_storage mps where mps.pass_num != 0 and mps.ng_num != 0 UNION SELECT DISTINCT ch.process_seq AS process_seq FROM micro_process_chain ch WHERE ch.active_flag = '1' UNION SELECT DISTINCT mmt.process_seq AS process_seq FROM micro_manufacture_task mmt

mws.submit_type = '2'

select a.id workSubmitId, a.product_seq productSeq, b.product_code productCode, b.product_name productName, c.nick_name submitUserNickName, a.created_date submitWorkDate, a.check_pass_num goodNum, a.check_ng_num ngNum, a.operate_process_seq processSeq, a.remark remark, a.check_status checkStatus, a.check_user checkUser, a.check_date checkDate, a.qc_date qcDate, a.qc_user qcUser from micro_work_submit a inner join micro_product b on a.product_seq = b.product_seq and a.tenant_code = b.tenant_code inner join micro_user c on a.submit_user = c.id and a.tenant_code = c.tenant_code

and mws.submit_type = #{submitType}
GROUP BY mws.product_seq HAVING totalNgNum > 0 ORDER BY totalNgNum DESC

SELECT mws.product_seq as productSeq, mws.operate_process_seq as processSeq, mpc.process_name as processName, sum( mws.check_ng_num ) - sum( mws.repair_num ) - sum( mws.abandoned_num ) AS ngNum FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON mws.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq
mws.submit_status = 0
and mws.product_seq in
#{productSeq}
GROUP BY mws.product_seq, mws.operate_process_seq HAVING ngNum > 0 ORDER BY ngNum DESC

SELECT mws.submit_user as submitUser, mu.nick_name as submitNickName, sum(check_ng_num) - sum(repair_num) - sum(abandoned_num) as totalNgNum FROM micro_work_submit mws LEFT JOIN micro_user mu on mws.submit_user = mu.id
mws.submit_status = 0
and mu.nick_name like concat('%', #{submitNickName}, '%')
and mws.submit_type = #{submitType}
GROUP BY mws.submit_user HAVING totalNgNum > 0 ORDER BY totalNgNum DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (submit_user)) as userNum, IFNULL(sum( check_ng_num ) - sum(repair_num ) - sum(abandoned_num), 0) AS totalNgNum FROM micro_work_submit
submit_status = 0
and submit_type = #{submitType}
and (check_ng_num - repair_num - abandoned_num) > 0

SELECT mws.product_seq as productSeq, mp.product_code as productCode, mp.product_name as productName, mws.operate_process_seq as processSeq, mpc.process_code as processCode, mpc.process_name as processName, mws.submit_user as submitUser, mu.nick_name as submitNickName, sum(check_ng_num) - sum(repair_num) - sum(abandoned_num) as ngNum FROM micro_work_submit mws left join micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mws.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code left join micro_process_common mpc on mws.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq and mws.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code left join micro_user mu on mws.submit_user = mu.id and mws.tenant_code = mu.tenant_code where mws.submit_status = 0 group by mws.product_seq, mws.operate_process_seq, mws.submit_user having ngNum > 0 order by ngNum desc

SELECT concat_ws('&',mws.product_seq,mws.operate_process_seq) as productAndProcess, mws.tenant_code as tenantCode, mws.product_seq as productSeq, mws.operate_process_seq as operateProcessSeq, mws.pre_process_seq as preProcessSeq, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mpc.process_name) FROM micro_process_common mpc where FIND_IN_SET(mpc.process_seq, mws.pre_process_seq) and mpc.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code) as preProcessName, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mpc.process_code) FROM micro_process_common mpc where FIND_IN_SET(mpc.process_seq, mws.pre_process_seq) and mpc.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code) as preProcessCode, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mpc.id) FROM micro_process_common mpc where FIND_IN_SET(mpc.process_seq, mws.pre_process_seq) and mpc.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code) as preProcessId FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN ( SELECT a.tenant_code , a.product_seq , a.operate_process_seq, max(a.id) AS id FROM micro_work_submit a WHERE a.submit_type='1' and a.is_first_process != '0'
and (a.product_seq,a.operate_process_seq) in
(#{item.productSeq},#{item.operateProcessSeq})
GROUP BY a.tenant_code , a.product_seq , a.operate_process_seq ) AS mws2 ON mws.id = mws2.id AND mws.tenant_code = mws2.tenant_code where mws.submit_type='1'
and (mws.product_seq,mws.operate_process_seq) in
(#{item.productSeq},#{item.operateProcessSeq})

SELECT concat_ws('&',mws.product_seq,mws.operate_process_seq) as productAndProcess, mws.tenant_code as tenantCode, mws.product_seq as productSeq, mws.operate_process_seq as operateProcessSeq, IF(MIN(mws.is_last_process) = 0, 1, 0) AS isLastProcess, IF(MIN(mws.is_first_process) = 0, 1, 0) AS isFirstProcess FROM micro_work_submit mws where mws.submit_type='1'
and (mws.product_seq,mws.operate_process_seq) in
(#{item.productSeq},#{item.operateProcessSeq})
GROUP BY mws.tenant_code, mws.product_seq, mws.operate_process_seq

select concat_ws('&',mp.product_seq,mp.id,mp.product_name)from micro_work_submit mws left join micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mws.tenant_code=mp.tenant_code
and mws.submit_status = #{submitStatus} and date_format(mws.created_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(#{createdDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by mp.product_seq,mp.id

SELECT mp.id AS itemId, mp.product_seq AS itemSeq, mp.product_code AS itemCode, mp.product_name AS itemName FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN micro_product mp ON mws.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code AND mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq WHERE mp.id in
#{id}
